Add dependence buffers around fold assessment observations

Source: R/neighbourhoods.R
buffer_folds.Rd

Existing omissions are retained. Only assessment observations define buffer centres; buffers do not recursively expand from other omitted observations.

Usage

buffer_folds(
  x,
  spatial = NULL,
  temporal = NULL,
  phylogenetic = NULL,
  combine = NULL,
  key = NULL,
  index = NULL,
  within = NULL
)

Arguments

x

A naboer_folds object.

spatial

A spatial_window() specification.

temporal

A temporal_window() specification.

phylogenetic

A phylogenetic_window() specification.

combine

Either "intersection" or "union"; required for multiple windows.

key, index

Optional tidy selections overriding the stored series key and temporal index for buffer construction.

within

For temporal searches, "key" or "domain". Required when purely temporal data contain multiple series. Defaults to "domain" for spatiotemporal searches.

Value

A naboer_folds object with expanded omission membership.
